review.gallery: Nine distinct native renders from the official brochure, project map and original Sky Villa plans. Shared sports and amenity visuals were excluded.
review.location: Original brochure map and travel panel were checked visually. The developer map directions resolve to the named first tower.
review.floorPlans: 27 complete drawings. The first six physical spreads of the Madena mirror were split at the gutter for selection while retaining all drawing content and the unchanged PDF. Seven duplex villa pairs and one additional floor plate are included. Duplicate amenity and site drawings in the Danube Sky Villas archive were listed once.

unavailable: Named metro station, exact second-tower entrance and signed unit-specific schedules were not established.
Danube website asset redistribution requires separate permission.
